Ek waiter galti se uske upar juice gira deta hai. Sabko lagta hai woh gussa karegi. Lekin Gray She smile karti hai aur calmly bolti hai, “It’s okay :)” Fir waiter ko tip bhi deti hai. Uska calm, classy aur kind behavior = Gracious.[STORY] Naeema ek luxury hotel mein internship kar rahi thi. Uska pehla din tha aur woh bahut nervous thi. Ek important dinner event chal raha tha jahan city ke rich businessmen aaye hue the.Naeema galti se ek guest ke expensive suit par coffee gira deti hai.Poori hall suddenly silent ho gayi.Sabko laga ab bahut bada scene hoga.Lekin woh guest, Mr. Zane, sirf softly smile kiya aur bola, “Relax, accidents happen.”Usne Naeema ko water diya kyunki woh khud panic mein almost ro rahi thi.Hotel manager bhi shocked ho gaya ki itna calm reaction kaise ho sakta hai.Dipti ne dheere se kaha, “He is really **Gracious**.”Dinner ke baad bhi Mr. Zane ne Naeema ko encourage kiya aur bola ki mistakes learning ka part hoti hain.Uska respectful aur forgiving behavior dekhkar sab uski **Gracious** personality ki baat karne lage.[USAGE][Koi waiter ya worker se politely baat karna | "She was gracious to the restaurant staff."][Kisi ki mistake ko calmly forgive karna | "He gave a gracious smile after the accident."][Guests ko warmly treat karna | "Our host was very gracious during [WORD] Horrendous[PHONETIC] huh-ren-duhs[DEFINITION] Bahut zyada terrible, unpleasant, horrible ya unbearable cheez.[NARRATIVE] Imagine traffic jam mein hazaar gaadiyon ke horn baj rahe hain, upar se muddy rain ho rahi hai, aur dust hawa mein udd rahi hai. Pure city ka scene unbearable ho gaya hai. Log bol rahe hain: “What a horrendous day!” Horn + Rain + Dust = Horrendous.[STORY] Dex apni bike lekar office ja raha tha. Subah already late ho chuka tha. Jaise hi woh main road par pahucha, usne dekha pura traffic completely jam hai.Har taraf loud horns baj rahe the.Upar se achanak heavy rain start ho gayi. Road ka muddy water bikes aur cars pe splash ho raha tha. Construction site ki wajah se dust bhi hawa mein udd rahi thi.Ek truck ne itna loud horn maara ki Dex almost bike se gir gaya.Woh frustrate hokar chillaya, “Yeh kitna **Horrendous** traffic hai!”Thodi der baad uska phone bhi rain mein band ho gaya.Office pahunchte tak uske clothes muddy ho chuke the, shoes wet the, aur mood completely kharab ho gaya tha.Naeema ne usko dekhkar bola, “Bro, you look like you survived a **Horrendous** disaster.”Dex sirf chair pe baith gaya aur silently chai peene laga.[USAGE][Bahut terrible traffic ya weather describe karna | "The traffic yesterday was horrendous."][Bahut ganda smell ya condition hona | "The room was in horrendous condition."][Kisi disaster ya accident ko describe karna | "They witnessed a horrendous [WORD] Exquisite[PHONETIC] ek-skwi-zit[DEFINITION] Bahut zyada beautiful, elegant, luxurious ya finely detailed cheez.[NARRATIVE] Imagine ek queen giant decorated eggs ke throne par baithi hai. Har egg pe gold artwork, jewels aur beautiful patterns lage hue hain. Pure palace mein sab log us throne ko dekhkar shocked ho jaate hain aur whisper karte hain: “How exquisite…” Eggs Queen Sit = Exquisite.[STORY] Kritika ko ek royal art exhibition ka invitation mila tha. Wahan duniya bhar ke rare luxury items display kiye gaye the.Lekin sabse zyada crowd ek special hall ke bahar tha.Jaise hi Kritika andar gayi, usne ek giant handcrafted necklace dekha jo diamonds, emeralds aur tiny golden flowers se bana hua tha.Har small detail perfectly designed thi.Lights uspar shine kar rahi thi aur poora necklace almost magical lag raha tha.Dex slowly bola, “This is absolutely **Exquisite**.”Us room mein paintings bhi thi jo itni detailed thi ki log unko minutes tak silently dekhte rehte the.Ek sculpture toh itna finely crafted tha ki woh almost real human jaisa lag raha tha.Naeema ne whisper kiya, “I have never seen such **Exquisite** craftsmanship.”Exhibition ke baad bhi sab log us luxurious aur elegant collection ki baat karte rahe.[USAGE][Bahut beautiful jewelry ya artwork describe karna | "She wore an exquisite necklace at the party."][Luxury food ya dessert ki beauty describe karna | "The restaurant served an Sabko lagta tha ki shayad billi ya hawa ki wajah se hua hoga.Ek din Dex ne CCTV lagaya. Raat ko video mein dikha ki Zorav khud scissors lekar flowers kaat raha tha. Woh dusron ke gardens barbaad kar raha tha taaki uska garden sabse sundar lage. Yeh bahut **malicious** behavior tha.Agli subah meeting hui. Kritika ne bola, “Agar kisi ko jealousy hai toh bhi aisa intentionally damage karna bahut **malicious** hai.”Zorav pehle deny karta raha, lekin jab video dikhaya gaya toh sab samajh gaye ki woh secretly colony ke plants destroy karta tha. Uski smile bhi thodi creepy thi, jaise usse dusron ko problem mein dekhkar maza aata ho. Colony wale uske **malicious** acts se kaafi upset ho gaye.[USAGE] [Office mein koi jaan-boojhkar dusre ka project kharab kare | He made a malicious attempt to ruin his coworker’s presentation.][School mein koi fake rumor spread kare kisi ko hurt karne ke liye | The student posted a malicious comment online.][Koi hacker intentionally damage karne wala virus bheje | The hacker used malicious software.][Colony mein koi purposely dusron ki property damage kare | The neighbor had malicious intentions.][Jealousy ki wajah se kisi ko emotionally hurt karna | Her malicious behavior shocked everyone.][LEVEL] 2[SVG] ```svg id="m46hz2"<!--Mnemonic Prompt:A jealous evil maali secretly cuts other people's flowers at night so only his own garden looks beautiful. [WORD] Reproach[PHONETIC] ri-PROACH[DEFINITION] Kisi ko galti ke liye criticize ya daantna in a disappointed way.[NARRATIVE] Imagine ek villain jiska naam Ripu hai. Woh har baar tumhare paas aata hai sirf complain aur criticism karne ke liye. Jaise hi woh approach karta hai, sab bolte hain: “Lo aa gaya Ripu-reproach!”[STORY] Valley Public School mein Darpan hamesha late aata tha. Ek din assembly ke baad principal Neeraj sir ne use office mein bulaya. Sir normally calm rehte the, lekin is baar unhone Darpan ko serious tone mein **reproach** kiya.“Tum intelligent ho, phir bhi roz late aana achhi baat nahi hai,” sir bole.Darpan ko laga shayad sir bas gussa karenge, lekin unka tone zyada disappointed tha. Woh sirf punishment nahi de rahe the, balki Darpan ko samjha rahe the ki uska behavior wrong hai. Yeh ek proper **reproach** tha.Baad mein Kritika ne kaha, “Aaj sir ne tumhe bahut calmly **reproach** kiya. Tum lucky ho detention nahi mila.”Us din ke baad Darpan ne seriously apni habits improve karni shuru kar di. Usse realize hua ki jab koi respect ke saath criticize karta hai, toh woh simple insult nahi hota, woh **reproach** hota hai.[USAGE][Parents bachche ko irresponsible behavior ke liye daante | His
